documents.text:
The old point_in_polygon_tool(point, polygon) was removed. The real replacement points_within_polygon_tool requires points=[point] and polygon; its response is points_within/count/total instead of inside/point. Preserving the old contract requires dynamic singleton-array construction and a count-to-boolean conversion, while retaining the original input point.
Public repository: https://github.com/mapbox/mcp-server
Old release: v0.11.0 (7d2c0f323915ebd4aeb3ff6721cae51c81300941)
New release: v0.12.3 (aae9e2fa777aab88809950032841675a844691df)
https://github.com/mapbox/mcp-server/blob/aae9e2fa777aab88809950032841675a844691df/CHANGELOG.md
No gate, native control or sealed observations are included.

newContracts.description: Test one or more geographic points against a polygon, returning only those inside. Handles a single point or a batch of points in one call. Useful for delivery zone validation, fleet geofencing, and customer segmentation. Works offline without API calls.

points.description: Array of points to test against the polygon

polygon.description: Polygon coordinates as array of rings (first is outer, rest are holes). Each ring is [longitude, latitude] pairs.

newContracts.name: points_within_polygon_tool

count.description: Number of points inside the polygon

points_within.description: Points that are inside the polygon

total.description: Total number of input points tested

oldContract.description: Test if a geographic point is inside a polygon. Useful for determining if a location is within a boundary, service area, or region. Handles polygons with holes. Works offline without API calls.

polygon.description: Polygon coordinates as array of rings (first is outer, rest are holes). Each ring is [longitude, latitude] pairs.

oldContract.name: point_in_polygon_tool

inside.description: Whether the point is inside the polygon
